answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 44596 Country: India Title: Borrowing Money Question: Can we borrow money from a non-Muslim friend? Answer ID: 44596 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 601/355/L=1434) You may borrow money from your non-Muslim friend. There is no harm in it as per the Shariah.
